transcript: Okay, let's talk keywords. Keywords are the most important part of a job description. Keywords are your way to figure out exactly what a company is looking for. With job descriptions this long, it can be hard to figure out what exactly a company is looking for. Really easy hack is downloading the Teal extension on Chrome. Just click on the duck and it's going to give you the top five hard skills needed for any job on a variety of different job sites, including your favorite ones like LinkedIn. If your resume shows proof that you have all five top hard skills, then it's probably a really good sign that you should apply. Like and follow for even more job tips.
